title: Training-free early exit for reasoning models: a linear probe folded into the row of the output layer [p]
summary: Reasoning models often reach the right answer early and then keep double-checking it for thousands of tokens. I got the model to stop at that point by changing a single row of weights. There's no training and no extra code at inference time; the edited model is an ordinary weight
